## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10692 — one family, folded into its closure card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T19:31Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10692, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same tool, same parity claim (the Debug run should answer as the runtime does), same files, and the same serial constraint behind PR objectui#10672. The current gate folds same-family findings into one closure card (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110), and objectui#10615, the family's first card, is in flight, so it is not folded into. objectui#10692 is the closure card for the remaining rows. It now carries this row (`visibleWhen` failing open on the legacy evaluator, in the screen preview and the Debug run's screen pause) with its measurement, at `priority:p2`. Neither card was claimed when the fold was made.
